subject: Goldleaf request: temporary extension to backup purge / log hold (DPA/subprocessor evidence needed)
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@goldleaf-health.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Diego,

We have an unexpected regulatory audit kicking off the week of Apr 19 for a product line that touches PHI. The audit team is asking us to provide unretracted logs and backups covering the last 18 months for a scoped env. Our legal/infosec needs confirmation from Redwood that you can pause the scheduled backup purge for this account and hold relevant KV logs while we run collection.

What Goldleaf needs:
- A temporary hold on automated backup purge for the Goldleaf tenant for up to 180 days (we understand long durations are rare).
- A targeted KV-log retention hold for the provisioning pipeline (log keys: gl-prod-provisioning-*) for the same window.
- A copy of your current subprocessor list and SOC 2 evidence for the past 12 months to feed our compliance pack.
- Draft DPA addendum language if an amendment is required — our procurement team needs this for DocuSign.

I realize this is a heavy ask on short notice. We can accept staging the hold (start with 60 days and extend by mutual agreement), but procurement is pushing for everything signed ASAP. Attached: audit-scope.pdf (redacted).

Can you confirm feasibility and any immediate blockers?

Thanks,
Aisha Gupta
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Goldleaf Health


From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Team — forwarding Goldleaf's ask. Quick summary: external audit, requests up to 180d pause on backup purge + KV-log hold for provisioning keys; also requesting subprocessor list / SOC2 evidence and a DPA addendum.

Questions I have for each of you:
- Kimberly: legal, what contractual constraints/approvals do we need to sign a temporary retention addendum? Is a short addendum ok or do we need procurement + sales approval?
- Marissa: ops, can we implement a customer-scoped backup-hold + key-specific log-retention override? What are the ops risks & cost estimate?
- Karthik: security, any major red flags if we retain KV logs longer for a single tenant (access controls, encryption, auditability)?

Goldleaf is open to starting with 60 days and extending, but they asked us to be able to go to 180d. They attached audit-scope.pdf.

I'll coordinate communications with Goldleaf after we have a feasible path and the legal ask.

-diego
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. Quick legal notes:
- We can offer a scoped DPA addendum that authorizes a temporary retention hold for specific artifact types (backups / KV logs) for a defined time window. That is preferable to a blanket contract change.
- We will need Goldleaf to sign an addendum (DocuSign) that includes: customer identifier, exact artifact names (or prefix), retention end date, cost/fee acknowledgement (if applicable), and a clause that defines escalation and termination conditions.
- Procurement should also confirm whether Goldleaf needs indemnities or special audit access; if so, get procurement sales looped.

I drafted a short addendum template (dpa-addendum-draft.docx) that covers a 90-day hold as the default with extension by mutual written agreement up to 180 days. If Goldleaf insists on 180d up front, we should attach a higher storage surcharge and require SOC2 + subprocessor attestation up front.

Next steps: Marissa to confirm implementation feasibility and storage/cost impact. Karthik to confirm controls and audit trail requirements so we can include them in the addendum. Diego, please ask Goldleaf whether they accept a default 90d + extension workflow or insist on 180d immediate.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Dir., Legal & Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Diego / Kim —

Operational feasibility notes: short answer — yes, we can implement a tenant-scoped backup-hold and a key-prefix KV-log retention override. Details / constraints:
- Implementation: create a hold tag on the Goldleaf tenant that flips the backup purge job to skip objects under s3://redwood-backups/goldleaf/* and add a retention flag for KV keys matching gl-prod-provisioning-*; runbook INF-8342 will be used to orchestrate collection.
- Default hold options we can support today: 30d, 60d, 90d. A straight 180d hold is operationally possible but requires an approval ticket (storage budget + incident ops standby) and a signed addendum first.
- Risk/cost: estimated incremental storage + retrieval cost for 90d hold is ~USD 4,300 (see storage-impact-estimate.pdf). 180d doubles that ballpark and increases our S3 lifecycle management complexity.
- Access & audit trail: we will enable fine-grained audit logging for any team members who access held artifacts and produce an access report for Goldleaf at the end of the hold.

Constraints: cannot suppress internal retention controls for security reasons; the hold will only pause the automated purge pipeline — artifacts remain encrypted and accessible to our ops on-call. We need the signed DPA addendum and SOC2/subprocessor attestation prior to enabling the 90+ day holds.

If Goldleaf accepts a staged approach, I recommend: 60d hold to start, run collection, and then extend if necessary to max 180d with renegotiated surcharge. I can prepare a short ops runbook and estimate and attach the storage-impact-estimate.pdf.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@goldleaf-health.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Diego —

Thanks for the quick internal loop. We appreciate the staged approach offer, but the audit scope requires 180 days of retained artifacts up front (audit committee mandate). Procurement is willing to sign higher storage fees and the addendum, but they asked if Redwood will accept a single amendment to enable 180d immediately rather than a staged 60/90 approach. They also asked whether the access report can be produced weekly for the audit team. Attached: audit-scope.pdf shows the fields they need.

Can you confirm whether we can get a path to immediate 180d hold conditioned on: signed addendum + SOC2 + current subprocessor list + a one-time non-refundable storage surcharge? We can get DocuSign ready ASAP if so.

Regards,
Aisha
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@goldleaf-health.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension on backup purge + log hold (audit)

Aisha —

Thank you — we can support an immediate 180-day hold conditioned on the items below:
1) Signed DPA addendum (we will send a DocuSign link) that references the exact artifact prefixes (backups + KV logs) and defines the hold start/end dates.
2) Receipt of Goldleaf's current subprocessor list and SOC 2 report (latest 12 months).
3) Agreement to the one-time storage surcharge; Ops estimate attached for transparency.
4) Weekly access reports for the audit team (we will automate a CSV export each Monday).

Kimberly will send the addendum via DocuSign; Marissa will create INF-8342 runbook tasks and enable the hold after we receive signed DocuSign and the attestations. Karthik will share the audit log access controls and our plan for limited IDP/role access.
